The vlogger is shown in the center of the image, wearing a white t-shirt and a black cap. He has a beard and is holding up his right hand with a blue glove on it, as if making a gesture or sign. Behind him, there are two other individuals, one wearing a bright green cap and another with a yellow shirt, both appearing to be part of the same group. The setting seems to be outdoors
